attribution.note: Zitron's own words in his own post. The parenthetical '(they won't)' is his assertion, not a quotation of anyone else.

semantics.note: 'They won't' is an unqualified negative forecast that OpenAI and Broadcom will not build their ASIC in 2026. The normalisation matches it. 'Build' is undefined, and the follow-on 'how many' hints at volume, but the drafter did not narrow it.

contract.note: The contract flags that 'build' could mean working chips or volume production. Both conditions defer to the speaker's meaning, which he did not supply. Lab samples would count under the first reading but not the second. There is no early-resolution rule.

evidence.note: OpenAI's own disclosure, dated 2026-06-24, before the cutoff: engineering samples are running in the lab and deployment is still to come. This is relevant but not decisive, because the deadline has not passed and the meaning of 'build' is unresolved. It is a company statement, not independent confirmation.
